facts.text: Students in the University Honors Program can earn an Honors Baccalaureate Degree by completing HONR 497, 498, and 499 and successfully defending both a thesis proposal and a final mentored research thesis.

sources.title: Honors Baccalaureate Thesis | University of Louisiana at Lafayette
sources.quote: Students who choose this pathway complete a faculty-guided thesis in addition to their regular Honors Program requirements, earning the Honors Baccalaureate Degree in their major.
